settings.title: Cooling circles
settings.about: Idle and done Claude circles in Agent Brief cool from hot to cold as the prompt cache ages.

settings.title: Hot colour
settings.about: A cache that was just used.

settings.title: Cold after
settings.about: Idle time after which the cache counts as expired. Claude's prompt cache lasts one hour.

settings.title: Toast on a cold tab
settings.about: When you switch to a cold Claude tab, one toast names its space and tab.

settings.title: Warn from (tokens)
settings.about: Smaller conversations get no toast and no cold mark: rewriting them is cheap.
